parsed.notes: The excerpt names a consolidated total net leverage ratio under the 2024 Credit Agreement in two ways. First, it sets the interest margin of 2.50%, 2.75% or 3.00%; the margin was 3.00% as of June 30, 2026. Second, the July 29, 2025 Amendment says the ratio will be maintained at its current level for the life of the agreement. Neither the actual ratio nor the numeric covenant limit is disclosed, so no covenant ratio values are reported.
